title: Delegation MCP bridge refetches /api/state twice per termal_send_to_session; cache child-ness for the bridge lifetime
outcome:
Claude reviewer, Low (perf), 2026-07-16: the delegation MCP bridge issues two full GET /api/state fetches per termal_send_to_session call (one in caller_is_delegation_child, one in resolve_session_reference) and one per tools/list. /api/state is summary-only but still serializes every session.
Child-ness is fixed for the bridge's lifetime, so cache it after the first resolution. The name->id resolution could also skip its fetch when the argument already looks like a session id. Not correctness-affecting; purely redundant work on a hot peer-messaging path.
disposal_reason: NOT PLANNED (backlog triage w-930e4d333f07, 2026-10-05; Greg's approval via Engram::Advisor #293). P3/P4, never started, no holder or children, untouched since before 2026-09-21, not reliability, data safety or pilot. The record is kept; reopen or re-file if it becomes relevant.
